d: Concerned About Their Sons' Poor Academic Performance, A Father Hires A Tutor. Both Brothers Become Attracted To Her, But Her Influence Fuels Rivalry Between Them—Ultimately Leading To A Devastating Act Of Violence.
Forced Into A Marriage He Resents, A Man Mistreats His Wife And Pursues Other Relationships. As She Struggles To Stand Up For Herself, She Turns To Her Mother-In-Law For Support And Justice.

A Grocery Store Assistant Develops Feelings For A College-Going Young Woman Who Frequently Visits The Shop. What Begins As A Silent Admiration Takes An Unexpected Turn When He Finally Gathers The Courage To Propose To Her.

A Yoga Professional Is Sexually Assaulted By A Man Whose House She Goes To Train. The Man Initially Acts As Someone Who Intends To Help Treat Her Ailing Father, But Ends Up Using Her For His Benefits.

Two brothers running a tailoring business secretly engage in illegal activities that exploit their customers' trust. When one family becomes affected by their actions, they decide to fight back. Their determination helps uncover the entire racket.

A Man Falls For A Woman Who Exploits His Affection For Money, Working With An Accomplice To Rob Him. As He Loses His Savings And His Marriage Begins To Collapse, He Must Face The Consequences Of His Choices.

A Widow Is Having An Affair With Her Brother-In-Law. The Mother-In-Law Always Suspects About The Affair. She Tries To Get Her Son Married To Another Woman. This Is When Envy Takes Place And Things Go Berserk.
